architecture: Structural composition of frozen dispatcher, DataMover engine, three MM2S adapters, one S2MM adapter and actual XPM-backed bank subsystem. Vendor DataMover and GEMM remain external.
critical_wiring: DMA local offset narrowed only after dispatcher high-bit legality check
completion_bank is dispatcher release identity while sequence tags remain diagnostics
owner-checked grants MM2S banks0..2 owner1 and S2MM bank3 owner2
explicit MM2S priority selection returns ready only to selected adapter
all unsupported adapter array entries inactive
